commands.command: set -e; git fetch origin work/phase1-live-call-probes; git checkout work/phase1-live-call-probes; git reset --hard origin/work/phase1-live-call-probes; echo HEAD=$(git rev-parse HEAD); echo STATUS_BEGIN; git status --short; echo STATUS_END; echo DEVICES_BEGIN; adb devices -l; echo DEVICES_END; SERIAL=RFCT70L7E8J; adb -s "$SERIAL" get-state; echo MODEL=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell getprop ro.product.model | tr -d '\r'); echo API=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell getprop ro.build.version.sdk | tr -d '\r'); echo CALL_STATE=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys telephony.registry 2>/dev/null | grep -m1 'mCallState=' | cut -d= -f2 | tr -d '[:space:]'); echo BLUETOOTH=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell settings get global bluetooth_on | tr -d '[:space:]'); echo SHIZUKU=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell ps -A -o USER,PID,NAME | grep -E '^shell[[:space:]]+[0-9]+[[:space:]]+shizuku_server$' || true); echo APP_PID=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell pidof pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge 2>/dev/null | tr -d '[:space:]'); test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; echo status_check_green=true
